I stayed at this PG in janteshwar society Bhandup for 3 months and overall had a very good experience. The place is peaceful, comfortable, and I didn’t face any issues during my stay.
They provide all necessary utilities like a fridge, washing machine, regular cleaning, and other basic facilities.

There are just two things to be aware of:

1. They have a 15-day deposit lock-in period after you leave, but they are genuine about it and I received my deposit exactly on time.

2. They also charge ₹3,000 for documentation / police verification, which felt a bit high.

Apart from these points, everything else was smooth and trustworthy. Overall, a reliable and peaceful place to stay.
